    Path data on a quotient by a two-sided ideal #

    Given path data in B and a two-sided ideal I, the vertices and arrows outside I form a quiver, and their images give path data in B ⧸ I (subPathData), with path values the images of the original ones (subPathData_pval). Every path outside I lifts (exists_lift).
